title: Gulf bourses slip as Houthi-Saudi clashes rattle investors
summary: Most Gulf bourses fell in early trade on Sunday, with investors unsettled by intensifying clashes between Yemen’s Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition. Saudi Arabia’s benchmark index declined 1.1%, weighed down by a 1.2% fall for oil behemoth Saudi Aramco. In Qatar, the index eased 0.3%, with Qatar National Bank— the Gulf’s biggest lender — losing 1.1%.

The ministry said the vessel was being used to supply the Ukrainian army. Russian forces also hit a logistics centre, a distribution centre and a logistics terminal in the Ukrainian city of Kharkiv. The ministry said the facilities had been used for storage and distribution of dual-use cargo for the Ukrainian military.
